## Line 123

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/sampling.library.plato, line 123](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/sampling.library.plato#L123).

```plato

    // The stored value at node (i, j, k), with every index edge-clamped.
    NodeValue(self: SampledScalarGrid3D, i: Integer, j: Integer, k: Integer): Number {
        var columns = self.NodeColumns;
        var rows = self.NodeRows;
        var ci = ClampIndex(i, columns);
        var cj = ClampIndex(j, rows);
        var ck = ClampIndex(k, self.NodeLayers);
        return self.Values[(ck * rows + cj) * columns + ci];
    }
```
